title: Auto MPG
citation: Quinlan, R. (1993). Auto MPG [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5859H
rawDataChanges: None. The distributed raw file is byte-identical to the acquired UCI archive member.
lessonSelection: One-based original row IDs are preserved. Model-year code 82 selects 31 records (IDs 368–398); row 375 has missing horsepower and is excluded from the two-objective comparison, leaving 30 records.
objectives: Maximize recorded mpg and horsepower, equivalently minimize their negations.
scope: Historical recorded catalogue; no causal, prospective or population performance claim.
derivedFiles: auto_mpg_pareto.results.json stores the already computed 255 cylinder-limit/mpg-floor comparisons. The supplied programme reproduces them from the unchanged raw file.
